title: Harness contract v1: inbox message
description: One operator message, stored as inbox/<timestamp>-<id>.json in the run directory.

mode.description: next: deliver at the next step or iteration boundary. now: interrupt the current step.

target.description: run: any later step of the run. step: the step named in step.

step.description: Step name when target is step.

delivered_at.description: Set when the message was injected into a step prompt. Absent or null while pending.

if.description: A step-targeted message must name its step.
